independence_declaration.statement:
I am code-security-reviewer, session fa28a399 (task T-DG5-REV-SEC-R1C, the second re-run of the round-1 code-security review). I authored no implementation in the DG5 scope.

Who authored the candidate:
- P5 was built by solution-architect, backend-workflow-engineer, kpi-benefits-engineer, frontend-ux-engineer and transformation-analyst (handbacks in docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/).
- qa-verifier wrote the acceptance tests (QA-A to QA-F2 authoring).
- The delivery-orchestrator integrated and froze it (D-141 to D-169).

What I wrote: evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/code-security/round-1/, this record and its findings sidecar. I did not read or cite the orphaned material of the two earlier runs.

How I ran code: builds, static checks and tests used a disposable clone at $TMPDIR/rv. It is a git clone --shared, non-shallow, with all 1441 commits reachable. The checkout is sparse: it leaves out docs/delivery/{test-evidence,handbacks,runs}, none of which is in the candidate manifest. A full checkout failed twice with ENOSPC on the shared disk. The clone used a private copy of the pnpm store and disposable PostgreSQL 16 clusters on ports 26500-26560 (tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh). My reproduction tests were copied into the clone only for their own runs and then deleted. One of them was still present when integration run 1 started; this is disclosed in SEC-R1-05.

The validators and candidate.mjs ran read-only in the repository tree. I formed my verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-1 record, and I have not read one. HEAD stayed at 9e4a314 for my whole run; it differs from source 601d7d2 only in docs/delivery records.

checks_run.actual:
RUN 1 (06-integration-locale-unset.log; 02:29-03:12Z):
- Every candidate file passed: 312 files, 3030 passed and 1 skipped of 3031. This includes contract.test.ts (83 tests) and the 0094/0096 database tests, and 88 migration files 0001-0096 were applied (see SEC-R1-14 for the numbering).
- The skip is presentation.test.ts's it.runIf(!hasMeetingPackAssembler), as D-169 says.

The extra file is apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r1-p5-sweep.test.ts, my own sweep (SEC-R1-08), which is not candidate code. It was in the clone when the run collected its files, and I deleted it before the run reached it, hence 'Cannot find module'.
- The other stderr/stdout lines in the log are the designed negative-path probes of passing tests: stalled and aborted bodies (408), the DB-side ECONNRESET probe, and the IdP-unavailable login.
RUN 3 (08-…clean.log): a clean re-run (status-lines=0). It died after about 3 minutes when the shared disk filled: demo.test.ts and demo-dev-binding.test.ts reported 'could not extend file …: No space left on device', and the log's own last write was mangled; exit 1.

- 2 are protection.test.ts assertions that read .constraint from the connection error (undefined). Those same tests passed in runs 1 and 2.
The df output in the logs shows the disk at 99-100%. Runs 3 and 4 are environmental, not product failures.
Conclusion: every candidate test ran and passed with the locale unset (run 1). The non-zero exits are fully explained: my own non-candidate file, and the shared disk running out of space.

checks_run.procedure:
My own contract-generated sweep. The existing aud-write-deny.test.ts excludes P5 operations, and each slice tests AUD itself.
(1) AUD (organization scope) calls all 90 P5 mutating operations on a real transformation. The other path parameters are synthetic, the body is {}, and If-Match and Idempotency-Key are set. Any 2xx fails, and the business audit trail must not grow.
(2) An ADM-only caller (ADM_ACCESS and ADM_TECH) calls all 40 transformation-scoped P5 reads. Any 2xx fails.
(3) The ADM-only navigation is printed.
checks_run.command: cp repro/p5-aud-adm-sweep.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r1-p5-sweep.test.ts; QA_PG_PORT=26540 bash tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --project integration <file>; rm <file>
checks_run.expected: No AUD write succeeds and nothing is written. The ADM-only caller sees no transformation-scoped P5 data.
checks_run.actual:
3/3 passed, exit 0.
(1) Out of 90 AUD calls: 73 × 403, 11 × 400 and 6 × 404, with 0 × 2xx. The business audit count was unchanged (101 before, 101 after); the only new events are 67 authorization.denied events by AUD.
- The 400s are body validation that runs before authorization on an empty body. The per-slice suites assert AUD 403 with valid bodies, for example day-ninety.test.ts:120 and the procedures and forms suites.
- The 404s are synthetic ids.
(2) Out of 40 ADM-only reads: 37 × 404, 3 × 403, 0 × 2xx.
(3) The ADM-only navigation shows my_work, playbook_procedures and administration, with no transformation-scoped area.
Two earlier executions of this file are disclosed:
- one failed on an import path ('./support/harness.ts');
- one failed only my own audit filter, which used the prefix 'access.%' where the actual action is 'authorization.denied'.
Both were fixed in the evidence copy; the log is the final run.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of procedures/{steps,instances}.ts, the outputs/** adapter kit and migration 0096 (D-166 Rule A, D-167). Then reproduce an organization-scope intake naming a transformation its actor cannot read.
checks_run.command: cp repro/intake-foreign-transformation.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/procedures/zz-sec-r1-intake-foreign.test.ts; QA_PG_PORT=26510 bash tests/qa/support/with-pg.sh npx vitest run --project integration <file>; rm <file>
checks_run.expected: A step output must be a record the actor can read. Rule A must allow exactly one transformation_id transition, and nothing else.
checks_run.actual:
FAIL, raised as F-DG5-101 (Medium, mandatory).
The sequence: TL1 (TL at organization and BU a1) gets 404 on GET X, where X is a BU a2 transformation created after the launch. TL1 then completes capture_intake with outputRecordId X and gets 200. The link (output, transformation, X) is written, draft_charter and confirm_sponsor adopt X, and X's lead TL2 can now read TL1's intake (200).
The cause: kit.ts:87-118 (inScope and producedHere) never checks the actor's read access.
What passed:
- The 0096 guard itself is exact: it allows only NULL to T for a pending step of an active organization-scope new_transformation_intake instance, to T as linked by the completed capture_intake step, and refuses every other change under the same constraint name. Its runtime-role refusal tests passed in runs 1 and 2.
- Adopted-step writes re-check grants in T (steps.ts:496-536).
- Every step write takes the procedureInstanceStep lock, the instance FOR UPDATE, and If-Match on the instance.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of automation/{identity,versions,dry-run,rules,lifecycle,failures}.ts, the worker twins (automation/identity.ts, actions/common.ts) and 0074-0076. Check the run-as identity (REQ-S12-003), the human-only refusals, the dry-run rollback, samplePayload, configuration scope, and retry without duplication.
checks_run.environment: Repository tree and clone (read-only); integration runs 1 and 2
checks_run.expected: Execution acts as the initiating user, with grants reloaded in the action's transaction, or as a service identity holding exactly the version's non-approval codes, inside the rule scope. Human-only actions are refused at the API and the database. The dry run writes nothing.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- decideActionAuthorization (scope first, then identity) is byte-identical between the API and worker twins.
- The worker planner reloads the initiating user's readership in its transaction (common.ts readersOf).
- validateContent refuses approval-category service permissions and human-only actions (versions.ts:276-278); AV01/AV04/AX05 back this up in the database.
- The dry run evaluates in a READ ONLY transaction that is always rolled back (the RolledBack throw), then writes only the dry-run row and its audit event after a commit-time re-check and a content-hash match.
- samplePayload is static synthetic data (samples.ts).
- The A13 suites (a13-*), automation-failures and automation-engine passed in runs 1 and 2.
Observation, not a defect: the dry-run plan and the execution history show planned recipient user ids to automation.configure and automation.read holders, ADM_METHOD and ADM_TECH among them, for any transformation in the rule's organization scope. That is the ADR-0043 §8 table, not a finding.

checks_run.procedure: Source review of reporting/exports/{routes,jobs}.ts, the worker export-runner.ts and @mth/reporting (storage, injection, csv, xlsx/sheet, model). Check download authorization, store keys and traversal, per-attempt files, the size limit, formula injection, the SUM template and decimals.
checks_run.expected: Only the requester can download, with read re-checked, and anyone else gets 404. Keys are opaque, with no traversal. Each attempt writes its own file and earlier ones are removed. Files are capped at 200 MiB. Text is neutralized in XLSX and CSV, formulas come only from the fixed template, and numbers are decimal end to end.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- ownJob filters on requested_by and re-checks transformation.read, returning 404 otherwise, for read, download and cancel.
- Create re-authorizes at commit time and is idempotent through the unique (requested_by, idempotency_key) plus ON CONFLICT.
- Keys are exports/<org>/<job>-a<attempt>.<ext>, validated by a regex, with '..' refused and a resolved-root check (storage.ts pathOf).
- discardEarlierAttempts removes earlier attempts, and EXPORT_MAX_BYTES enforces 200 MiB.
- Content-Disposition is sanitized, with nosniff and no-store.
- The worker re-checks the requester's grants at START (requesterHolds mirrors grantApplies and is stricter, failing closed).
- Injection triggers are = + - @ TAB CR. XLSX text is always inlineStr with quotePrefix and is never an <f>. CSV prefixes with '. A <f> is emitted only from sumFormula, with integer-checked ranges.
- Decimal values match DECIMAL_PATTERN, are re-parsed by reportDocument before rendering, and are summed with decimal.js. A P5 diff scan for parseFloat/Number on money found only integer and pagination uses.
- The a15-* suites ('=HYPERLINK(...)' exported as text, SUM kept) passed.

checks_run.procedure: Review the relay (apps/worker/src/relay.ts, unchanged in P5), OUTBOX_EVENT_SCHEMAS, the outbox-registry test, the advisory-lock registry and the unique backstops.
checks_run.environment: Repository tree; unit and integration runs
checks_run.expected: Every enqueued type is registered, an unregistered type never stalls later events, and replay is a no-op.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- outbox-registry.test.ts enumerates 27 enqueued types and the 16 write sites, and passes (unit-node). report_snapshot.issued is written only once it is registered.
- publishNext takes the oldest row with attempts < 10, using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. A row whose type has no schema is marked last_error, and the round ends. After 10 one-second polls it is skipped, so later events are delayed by at most about 10 s and never stalled.
- Replay safety rests on deterministic job ids (fanOutJobId), singletonKey, the consumer ledger, createWorkItemOnce and the export (requested_by, key) unique.
- a13-durable-automation, a13-starters-run and the replay ×3 tests passed in runs 1 and 2.

checks_run.procedure: Review migrations 0062-0096: forward-only, numbering, guards, audit coverage, grants. Judge 0094's one-off trigger disable (ADR-0039 C2) and 0096.
checks_run.expected: Forward-only, guarded and audited. 0094 is acceptable only if it is atomic and changes nothing else.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- All 88 migration files apply to a fresh database in each integration run.
- The numbering has documented gaps: 0066-0067, 0073, 0077-0079 and 0083-0084 are the 'free; used only if a handback shows a database need' reservations in p5-work-split.md §§A, B/C, D/E and F, never taken. The migrator (DG1, unchanged) applies lexically pending files, so these numbers must stay unused. I record this as an observation.
- form_record_type is SELECT-only for mth_app (0068:45), so the dynamic identifiers in forms come from migrations only.
- 0094 is accepted. It disables gate_instance_row_guard and gate_instance_audit_required only around one UPDATE, inside the migration's single transaction (ALTER TABLE takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE). The UPDATE sets only the new column, and only from existing gate_instance.configure audit facts. Version, updated_* and the ETags are unchanged, and the triggers are re-enabled before commit. Its backfill test passed.
- 0096 is exact, as described in SEC-R1-10.

checks_run.procedure: Review packages/db/src/demo/{guard,seed,reset,cli}.ts, packages/db/src/cli.ts, config MTH_ENV/AUTH_MODE and the snapshot synthetic member.
checks_run.expected: Seeding is refused in production and on a production-marked or non-empty database. The dev-issuer binding happens only with AUTH_MODE=dev outside production. The demo access admin holds no approval right. synthetic appears only in a demo database.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- seedDemoRefusal refuses MTH_ENV=production, a production marker, an existing demo, and a non-empty database.
- MTH_ENV defaults to production when NODE_ENV=production.
- demoDevIssuerBindingAllowed requires NODE_ENV !== production && AUTH_MODE === dev (guard.ts:129), and the config also refuses AUTH_MODE=dev with NODE_ENV=production (load.ts:197).
- DEMO_ACCESS_ADMIN is ADM_ACCESS, a technical_admin kind, which the 0001 trigger forbids from holding approval or finance categories.
- The snapshot gets synthetic only when readDeploymentEnvironment says demo; with no marker it is treated as production, which is fail-safe.
- demo.test.ts and demo-dev-binding.test.ts passed in runs 1 and 2.

checks_run.procedure: Review workflows/{approval-routes,conditional-approval,scale,gates}.ts and 0075. Check sequential and parallel routes, the SoD of the requester, technical admins never being approvers, routedApproverOf/approver_configured, and conditional scope.
checks_run.expected: Only an ACTIVE step is decidable, by a holder of approval.decide in scope who is not the requester. No technical admin or AUD is an approver. A conditional G5 blocks out-of-scope scaling.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- decideRouteStep refuses a step that is not active, and refuses the requester under requester_excluded (approval-routes.ts:542-556). The next step is activated only after the current one is approved.
- 0075:131 refuses a technical_admin or AUD approver role, and the 0001 trigger refuses approval permissions on technical_admin roles.
- The scale guards are in SQL (0051).
- The suites passed in both runs: approvals/* (REQ-S10-015), gates/*, the conditional G5 test (REQ-S04-011) and the 0094 tests.

checks_run.expected: No injection, no unvalidated JSON, all pending lists empty, and an acyclic, port-wired graph.
checks_run.actual:
PASS.
- Attachments re-check the record type's write permission in scope at commit time, and evidence_link keeps evidence.create.
- The register's sql.raw fragments are module constants (EVIDENCE_LINK_SOURCES).
- The logo is PNG-only: signature, 67 B to 256 KiB, SVG refused (branding.ts:244).
- All 43 p5-pending-*.ts leaf lists are empty, including P5_PENDING_TESTS_BE_O and _BE_J; the six ARCH lists only spread them.
- A grep finds no import of workflows or admin under modules/reporting, and no apps/api import under apps/worker; architecture.testkit passed.
- Custom values validate against the schema (REQ-S16-010; forms suites passed).
- REQ-S13-010 evidence versions and checksums: the evidence suites passed.
- REQ-S15-004 and REQ-S01-002 branding: the branding suites passed.
- REQ-S05-001 and REQ-S05-006: the forms suites passed.

checks_run.environment: Orchestrator evidence docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/orchestrator-D-169/; my unit logs; repository tree
checks_run.expected: Each is accepted with a reason, or raised as a finding.
checks_run.actual:
All are accepted.
- The AUD e2e: p2-journeys.spec.ts:1157 took 32.0 s against its 30 s limit during the orchestrator's concurrent validator run. It took 20.2 s (en) and 16.6 s (ar) in the locale-unset run, and the C.UTF-8 re-run alone passed 24/24 (18.1 s and 16.9 s). I did not re-run e2e myself, because of the full shared disk and concurrent load. This is accepted as load-induced, with the observation that the unloaded margin is about 10 s.
- Unit stderr lines (1) to (4): explained in SEC-R1-03. The untraced line (3) is now traced to the charter host test not stubbing the north-star read.
- (a) 0075's table comment: the applied migration is immutable, the database constrains only length and uniqueness, and ADR-0044 §7 states the merged key.
- (b) ADR-0044 B2's shorthand: superseded by §7 and B4, and the producer parses with the strict 4-member schema (events.ts).
- (c) The D-168 wording: a code comment at roaming.ts:665.
None of these has any behavioural effect.

checks_run.command: pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile; ls .github/workflows; grep guard and config rules; grep ENV_VARS for AI/LLM/SMTP/WEBHOOK; pnpm deps:verify (attempted)
checks_run.expected: PASS on the offline/config surface, with each residual noted.
checks_run.actual:
PASS on the offline/config surface (11-residual-surfaces-offline.log, run on the intact clone at 04:33Z).
- Registry: the offline frozen-lockfile install succeeded (lockfile v9).
- CI: ci.yml and delivery-gates.yml are present. Live CI is the D-058 residual.
- IdP: the D-165 dev binding is gated on AUTH_MODE=dev and non-production (guard.ts:129, load.ts:197), and demo-dev-binding.test.ts passed. Keycloak is the D-049 residual.
- No AI or external notification adapter variable exists in ENV_VARS, which matches D-142 Q11.
About 10-residual-surfaces.log (cited for honesty, not relied on): `pnpm deps:verify` needs `npm view` against the live registry. It gave no output for more than 12 minutes in the network-less sandbox. It returned only after I had deleted the disposable clone during cleanup, so every line after its header ran in a deleted directory and says nothing about the candidate:
- the 'node_modules missing' / ELIFECYCLE exit=1;
- "ls: cannot access '.github/workflows'";
- "grep: packages/config/src/index.ts: No such file";
- "fatal: Unable to read current working directory".
A dated note is appended to that log. deps:verify is not counted; it is the D-057 live-registry residual.
